design-system.note: NEVR-856 — outtrue 0.2.0 as the second design-system gate (TRIAL→ADOPT: the probe's 45 findings shrank to a recorded zero in the landing PR; every error names its fix). The recommended 15-rule set runs at error in the same lint:design pass as @shadcn/lint — outtrue covers the rule classes shadcn does not (rebuilt primitives, icon-button a11y, closed variants, duplicate primitives, template classnames, wrapper contracts). primitives = src/components/ui, so wrapped-libraries passes by construction: ui/menu.tsx lives inside the primitives folder and its @base-ui/react/menu import IS the wrapper contract — no allowlist entry exists or is needed. The three no-rebuilt-primitives overrides below are the recorded decisions for all 26 raw <button> sites (shell 14, board 9, home 3) — vocabulary chrome the mockup port owns, where Button's .btn/.ghost/.pri variants would restyle the port: (1) src/components/shell/** — the shell chrome is a 1:1 port of docs/design/shell/shell.css emitted from src/styles/app.css; the rail .v, tab-strip .tab-btn/.x/.tabs-more/.newtab, sidebar .row/.ib and header .search buttons ARE that port's vocabulary. (2) src/components/board/** — the board surfaces are the mockup port class-for-class: .ib icon buttons (add ticket, prev/next month, favorite), .vtab view tabs (role=tab), .x filter-chip close; Button is already used wherever the mockup chrome fits (New ticket, Filter, Display, Today, Triage with agent). (3) src/components/home/** — the .seg inbox filter is a native fieldset group (NEVR-505 a11y) in mockup vocabulary; its buttons carry no .btn chrome by design, and the toolbar's real CTA is already Button variant=primary. Each entry turns off ONLY no-rebuilt-primitives — every other rule (including no-template-classname) still fires on these surfaces. A new entry here is a recorded decision, never a convenience.
